scope: RoboTwin and MuJoCo first-pass physics for every Xbox One S control represented by the licensed visual asset

small_buttons.applicability: Numerical proxy only; no Xbox small-button force measurement is available.

shoulders.travel: artist cap travel; the reference switch travel is not substituted for lever travel

triggers.applicability: Cross-control torque scale used only as a simulation placeholder; it is not an Xbox trigger measurement.

sticks.tilt_dynamics: reuse references/left_stick.json for both identical reference modules
sticks.tilt_joint_friction_basis: Selected by the owner after the 2026-10-09 bounded free-root shake search bracketed the 0.01-signal transition between dimensionless PhysX joint-friction coefficients 0.076123046875 and 0.076171875. The adopted 0.1 is a simulation setting, not an identified Xbox parameter.

dpad.lever_arm_basis: rounded half-width of the metric-scaled D-pad visual
dpad.applicability: First-pass rocker estimate; Xbox membrane force and cap lever ratio are unmeasured.

collision_policy.method: Repair the meshbase into closed shells, then apply CoACD per component and per shell; CoACD replaces primitives by default, with SDF available as a loading option
collision_policy.coordinate_frame: simulation (x,-z,y), Z up; metres; meshbase already converted

coacd.defaults: All other parameters use coacd 1.0.14 defaults, including preprocess_mode=auto, decimate=False, max_convex_hull=-1.
coacd.max_ch_vertex_note: Explicit 255 matches all Phase A runs; CoACD uses it only when decimate=True, so it is inactive here.

limitations: Cannot collide with an add_ground plane
Cannot collide with another SDF object

collision_policy.uncertainty_applicability: Stage A sampled distances relative to meshbase, not a mechanical replica or hardware clearance measurement; repaired shell uses its rerun.

accepted_known_error.description: Approximately 1–1.5 mm of outward expansion in the touchable D-pad and stick-opening regions is provisionally accepted; revise after simulation experiments establish its effect on results

mass_policy.method: Closed meshbase volume × density × component fill factor; the body receives the remaining mass

stick_fill_derivation.rounding: 2 decimal places; shared by left/right stick
stick_fill_derivation.union_method: manifold3d 3.5.4 union of the two closed left-stick meshbase shells
stick_fill_derivation.applicability: Simulation estimate preserving the left-stick reference mass scale; not a measured polymer fill ratio
stick_fill_derivation.uncertainty: Meshbase shape and density/fill assumptions are uncalibrated; rounding prevents exact 0.004 kg recovery

mass_policy.minimum_mass_method: Clamp moving mass to minimum_moving_mass_kg and scale the complete centroidal inertia tensor by the same mass ratio; preserve shape.

passive_preload_policy.applies_to: buttons, shoulders, triggers, stick clicks and Pair
passive_preload_policy.does_not_apply_to: bidirectional stick tilt and D-pad rocker joints
passive_preload_policy.derivation: The no-preload MuJoCo trigger settled at 1.216% of travel under gravity; 1.5% adds a 0.284 percentage-point stop preload margin.
passive_preload_policy.status: simulation estimate derived from the no-preload run; replace with measured preload

signal_policy.button_output: continuous [0,1] travel fraction; consuming task chooses a digital threshold
device_neutral_applies_to: left and right trigger normalized travel
signal_policy.derivation: 2026-10-12 owner-selected 0.02 radial stick deadzone for simulation/game input. With the unchanged owner-selected PhysX tilt-joint friction coefficient 0.1, spring return can stop at normalized residuals about 0.005–0.0101; 0.02 leaves margin. This is a simulation setting, not a measured hardware value. Inside the radial deadzone output is zero, outside it values are not rescaled. The 2026-10-09 shake-experiment friction provenance is retained in control_groups.sticks.tilt_joint_friction_basis; the remaining 1e-4 device epsilon is unchanged.

microsoft_xinput.observation: Microsoft assigns dead-zone filtering to the application and calls post-dead-zone normalization optional.

sdl3.observation: SDL_GetGamepadAxis returns the current signed 16-bit axis state and documents zero as a valid centered value; it does not specify an automatic dead-zone transform.

w3c_gamepad.observation: The Gamepad specification linearly normalizes logical axis values to [-1,1]; it does not define a gameplay dead-zone remap.

dpad_contact_closure.rule: Independently suppress each split D-pad channel below threshold; preserve amplitude at/above threshold, including true diagonals.
dpad_contact_closure.reason: 30% separates small solver/contact cross-axis motion from intentional contact closure; selected for simulation testing, not inferred from measured Xbox switches.
dpad_contact_closure.uncertainty: No physical switch closure-angle measurement; the fraction may vary by direction, hysteresis, manufacturing tolerance and wear. A shared threshold is provisional.
dpad_contact_closure.calibration: Measure rocker angle/normalized travel while separately monitoring each electrical contact on repeated press/release cycles, including diagonals; estimate per-direction close/open thresholds and hysteresis, then replace this test value.

stick_neutral_history.derivation: The 0.01 radial stick deadzone is the owner-selected simulation/game-input threshold. Stick values inside it are zeroed and values outside are not rescaled. The remaining 1e-4 device epsilon only clears solver residue on triggers, buttons and D-pad; it is not a measured hardware deadzone.

known_unknowns: Trigger torsion spring and compliant end-stop curves
D-pad membrane force and exact diagonal envelope
Cap-to-shell clearances and hidden guide geometry
Pair button has no canonical game action channel
replacement_plan: Replace estimated values with owner measurements listed in docs/pending_user_review.md without changing joint or channel names.
